16K likes, 114 comments - harman_fitness_mommy on September 8, 2026: "I always thought the first thing to look for in honey was simply: is it pure? 🍯

But then I discovered AGMARK Special Grade — the highest grade under AGMARK, with stringent quality specifications.

Dabur Honey is tested across 22 quality parameters, including checks for sugar adulteration, heavy metals and antibiotic residues, with traceability from source to factory.

Because when it’s part of your everyday routine, knowing the quality behind it matters too. 🤍

Pure honey. Special Grade certified. 🍯

#DaburHoney #AGMARK #SpecialGrade #PureHoney #QualityMatters InformedChoices".
